title: Velvety Light French Cream Choux Pastry
description: A fresh and aerated French dessert featuring red wine jelly and render-fat, suitable for sugar-free diets. This dish is perfect for special occasions and monsoon season.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, combine the water, milk, and butter, and bring to a boil.
Add the flour and salt to the saucepan, and stir to combine.
Remove the saucepan from the heat, and let cool for 5 minutes.
Add the eggs to the saucepan, one at a time, stirring to combine after each addition.
Transfer the dough to a piping bag, and pipe onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the pastry for 15 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pastry from the oven, and let cool completely on a wire rack.
Drizzle the red wine jelly over the cooled pastry, and serve.
